description: MiniMax H3: 5-second videos from text or a first frame, with up to nine reference images, at 768p or 2K. Compared with other video tools: mid-priced. Price: from $0.108 per second (one call: from $0.541 per 5-second video), charged only on success. Price depends on resolution: 768P $0.541, 2K $0.879 (default 768P). One call = one 5-second video.
